pillars.name: Materials
pillars.claim: Some processes deliver a valuable advantage in microgravity.
pillars.artifact: Earth-control comparisons, uncertainty, and application-specific performance.
pillars.next: Establish independent experimental units and an optimized Earth control before estimating our own advantage.

pillars.name: Foundry design
pillars.claim: Multiple processes can share infrastructure while retaining specialized equipment.
pillars.artifact: A compatibility map, resource budgets, and explicit separation requirements.
pillars.next: Replace placeholder loads with measured requirements; validate cross-contamination and disturbance boundaries.

pillars.name: Fleet operations
pillars.claim: Coordinating production across capsules improves delivery, utilization, or cost.
pillars.artifact: A seeded simulation against FIFO, earliest due date, and dedicated operation.
pillars.next: Stress-test changing demand and return cadence; calibrate workloads and logistics before operational claims.

phases.label: 01 / Define the test
phases.exit: One material × process × application, with a measurable Earth benchmark.

tasks.title: Lock the three claims and their evidence boundaries
Choose one lead product for the demo
tasks.deliverable: One-page target-product profile: customer, performance metric, comparator, qualification gate

tasks.title: Develop the problem and foundry story for the video
tasks.deliverable: Video storyboard using published, modeled and untested labels

phases.label: 02 / Establish the evidence
phases.exit: Traceable files, calibrated measurements, and independent experimental units.

tasks.title: Recalculate one published flight / Earth comparison
tasks.deliverable: Pembrolizumab Table 1 comparison with extraction notes

tasks.title: Inventory NASA DSI and verify a bounded image pilot
tasks.deliverable: Object manifest, SHA-256 checksums and descriptive image QC

tasks.title: Map ground controls, run IDs and physical calibration
tasks.deliverable: Inclusion/exclusion table and data dictionary; no frame-level pseudoreplication

tasks.title: Extract validated features across complete runs
tasks.deliverable: Run-partitioned Parquet features, held-out runs, manual annotation audit

phases.label: 03 / Test the shared foundry
phases.exit: A feasible schedule with explicit resource and isolation constraints.

tasks.title: Map common services and dedicated cartridge internals
tasks.deliverable: Published EXPRESS/MSRR precedent, power bound and interactive compatibility map

tasks.title: Replace placeholder loads and characterize interference
tasks.deliverable: Stage-level power, heat, optics, field and vibration requirements with sources

tasks.title: Compare dedicated, sequential and concurrent layouts
tasks.deliverable: Pareto trade-off: useful throughput, mass, heat margin, failure isolation

phases.label: 04 / Benchmark the fleet
phases.exit: A reproducible policy comparison that reports losses as well as gains.

tasks.title: Implement identical-workload scheduling baselines
tasks.deliverable: FIFO, earliest due date, dedicated and coordinated policies; paired seed uncertainty

tasks.title: Run demand, changeover, failure and return-cadence sweeps
tasks.deliverable: 24 scenarios × 100 paired evaluation seeds; scenario explorer and full raw outputs

tasks.title: Add measured workloads and credible return logistics
tasks.deliverable: Calibrated capacities, downmass, launch/return windows and disruption assumptions

phases.label: 05 / Make the case
phases.exit: Every number can be traced to a source or a repeatable run.

tasks.title: Connect a lab request to a mission plan and batch record
tasks.deliverable: One end-to-end demo: input, recommendation, constraints, evidence and uncertainty

tasks.title: Audit the site and video against the evidence register
tasks.deliverable: Reproducible demo package, source list, limitations and next experiment

dataPlan.action: List metadata first; retain accession, object key, version, size, checksum and access date.
dataPlan.scale: Kilobytes of metadata before gigabytes of images

dataPlan.action: Read run protocols; identify gravity, hardware, composition, temperature history, pixel scale and timing.
dataPlan.scale: One complete run + matched Earth control

dataPlan.action: Validate interface, particle-order or connectivity features against blinded manual annotations.
dataPlan.scale: CPU array per run; GPU only if a validated model needs it

dataPlan.action: Hold out entire runs or flights. Bootstrap independent samples; use hierarchical models only when replication supports them.
dataPlan.scale: Run-level tables; never treat adjacent frames as independent trials

dataPlan.action: Connect structural proxies to an application test. Report effect, uncertainty, sensitivity and cost assumptions separately.
dataPlan.scale: Compact evidence cards and next-experiment priorities
